headlines.title: 'K-국부펀드' 설립 논의 시작 …" 상반기 중 방안 마련 "
headlines.summary: 재경부, 한국판 국부펀드 설립 방향 논의 위한 간담회 "유망산업에 장기 지분 투자…미래 세대와 국부 나눌 것" "상반기 중 설립 방안 마련하고 국회에 법안 제출 예정" [세종=뉴시스] 강종민 기자 = 세종시 어진동 정부세종청사 재정경제부. 2026.01.06. ppkjm@newsis.

headlines.title: 임광현 국세청장 “ 다주택자 편법 증여, 가산세 40% 물 수도 ”
headlines.summary: SNS 통해 편법증여 전수 검증 예고 “정상이면 양도가 증여보다 부담적어” 다음달 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예가 종료되는 가운데 임광현 국세청장이 29일 세금을 피하기 위한 다주택자들의 편법 증여를 철저하게 검증하겠다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 서울 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균가 10억 넘었다
headlines.summary: 대출 규제·전세난에 중저가 매수 쏠림 6개월새 11%↑, 모든 면적 중 상승률 최고 “구매력 부족 실수요자, 작은 아파트 몰려” 서울의 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균 가격이 처음으로 10억원을 돌파했다. 대출 한도 축소가 덜한 중저가 아파트로 매수세가 모이며, ‘좁은 집’의 몸값이 폭등하고 있는 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 정부 ‘ 건설사 구하기 ’… 표준단가 공시 연기
headlines.summary: 예년보다 일주일 늦춰 내달 8일 중동전쟁 여파 물가인상분 반영 중동전쟁 장기화에 따른 공사비 급등으로 건설사들의 부담이 커지자 정부가 건설사 구하기에 나섰다. 올해 하반기 발주될 공공 공사의 표준 단가 발표 시기를 일주일가량 연기해 전쟁에 따른 물가 인상분을 최대한 반영하기로 한 것이다.

headlines.title: 나프타 보조금에 업계 ‘ 숨통 ’… 스폿 물량 확보
headlines.summary: 여천NCC 가동률 55 → 65% 극단적인 공급절벽 상황 완화 원료값 비싸 ‘역마진’은 여전 미국·이란 전쟁발 나프타 수급난에 직격탄을 맞았던 국내 석유화학기업들이 나프타분해시설(NCC) 가동률을 높이면서 극한 위기 상황은 넘어간 것으로 분석됐다.

headlines.title: 중동사태에 기업들 투자 미루고 부채상환
headlines.summary: 지난달 회사채 잔액 0.2% 감소 발행 목적도 차환 용도가 85% 시설 투자 위한 발행액은 ‘제로’ 중동 전쟁과 고금리 여파로 불확실성이 커지면서 기업들이 미래를 위한 투자보다는 당장의 생존을 위해 부채 상환에 주력하는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 원전 업계, 해외 진출 경험 부족... 정부 "첫걸음 지원 강화 "
headlines.summary: <연합뉴스> 정부가 원전 수출 업계를 돕기 위해 해외인증 취득 등 수출지원사업을 확대한다. 수출실적이 부족한 중소·중견기업엔 '수출 첫걸음 지원정책'을 강화한다. 산업통상자원부는 20일 한국원전수출산업협회와 공동으로 '원전 기업을 위한 수출 설명회'를 갖고 이같이 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 뽑겠다는 중기, 일하겠다는 외국인 … 현장선 ‘ 미스매치 ’ 심각
headlines.summary: 중진공, 중기·유학생 대상 조사 기업·외국인 약 80% ‘채용·취업 희망’ 정부·지자체, 공공 취업매칭 강화 필요 네팔에서 온 외국인 근로자들이 인천국제공항 제2터미널을 통해 입국하고 있다.  [뉴시스] 중소기업 10곳 중 8곳가량은 외국인 유학생과 구직자를 채용할 의향이 있는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 女 가사노동 가치 연 1천650만원 … 성별 격차 3.2→2.7배로 축소
headlines.summary: 가사노동 총가치 582조·GDP 대비 23%…외주화·가전 발달로 비중은 하락 반려동·식물 돌봄 60% 늘어…미성년 -1.8%, 성인 20.8% 여성 1인 가사노동 연 1천650만원…남성, 여전히 '3분의 1' 수준 [연합뉴스TV 제공] (세종=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 여성 1명이 가사노동으로 창출하는 가치가 약 1천646만원에 달하는 것으로 조사됐다.

headlines.title: 돈 안 받는 집안일도 GDP 23% 규모 … 582조 가치
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 가정관리 78% 압도적…남성 증가율, 여성의 2배 이상 여성 425조 vs 남성 156조…격차는 여전, 참여는 확대 2024년 가계생산 위성계정. 국가데이터처 제공 청소·요리·돌봄 등 돈을 받지 않는 집안일도 경제적 가치가 582조 원에 달하며 국내총생산(GDP)의 약 23% 수준이라는 분석이 나왔다.

headlines.title: 60세 이상 정년연장시 임금 조정 …재계 ‘연령차별 예외’ 法명시 요구...
headlines.summary: 30일 與 정년연장특위 재계 간담회 60세 이상 임금 삭감시 소송전 우려 노동계 반발 전망…상반기 내 결론 정부·여당이 ‘정년 65세 연장’을 추진하고 있는 가운데, 재계에서 ‘60세 이상 근로자의 임금을 개편하더라도 연령 차별에 해당하지 않는다’는 내용을 법에 명시할 것을 요구할 계획인 것으로 확인됐다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea to Establish National Wealth Fund in First Half of 2026
key_headlines.summary: The Ministry of Economy and Finance announced plans to establish a Korean-style sovereign wealth fund for long-term strategic investments in promising industries. The government aims to finalize the establishment plan in the first half of 2026 and submit legislation to parliament.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Small Apartments Under 60 Square Meters Surpass 1 Billion Won Average Price
key_headlines.summary: Small apartments in Seoul have exceeded 1 billion won in average price for the first time, rising 11% in six months due to loan regulation constraints and housing shortage. Demand has shifted to smaller units as affordable options become scarce.

key_headlines.title: US Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady for Third Consecutive Time Amid Middle East War Concerns
key_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve maintained interest rates at 3.50-3.75% while expressing concerns about inflation remaining elevated due to global energy price increases from Middle East tensions. Four dissenting votes indicated significant policy disagreement among Fed officials.

key_headlines.title: NPS Commissioner Warns of 40% Penalty Surcharge on Multi-Property Owners' Illegal Gift Transfers
key_headlines.summary: The National Tax Service announced strict verification of tax evasion schemes by multi-property owners, with potential penalty surcharges up to 40% for illegal gift transfers. This comes ahead of the June 9 expiration of preferential treatment for multi-property sales taxes.

key_headlines.title: Google Parent Alphabet Reports 22% Revenue Surge Driven by AI Investment Growth
key_headlines.summary: Alphabet achieved record first-quarter revenue growth of 22% to 163 trillion won, with cloud services revenue surging 63%. The company is reducing NVIDIA dependence through development of its eighth-generation Tensor Processing Units.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea announced plans to establish a national wealth fund for strategic long-term investments in promising industries, aiming to finalize details in the first half of 2026. The government delayed announcement of standard construction costs by one week to account for Middle East war-induced price increases affecting construction companies. Seoul's small apartments under 60 square meters reached 1 billion won average price for the first time, with 11% growth in six months due to loan regulation constraints and increased demand from price-sensitive buyers. Domestic petrochemical companies, hit by naphtha supply shortages from the US-Iran war, are increasing NCC facility operating rates from 55% to 65% with government naphtha subsidy support. The National Tax Service announced strict crackdowns on multi-property owners' illegal gift transfers to avoid capital gains taxes, with potential 40% penalty surcharges.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The US Federal Reserve held interest rates steady at 3.50-3.75% for the third consecutive time, citing elevated inflation from global energy price increases due to Middle East tensions. The Fed expressed significant uncertainty about economic outlook given geopolitical developments and noted that job growth remains low while unemployment has stabilized. German consumer price inflation reached 2.9% in April, the highest in over two years, with energy prices surging 10% due to Middle East conflict impacts. The central bank's decision revealed notable policy divisions with four dissenting votes on interest rate decisions, indicating internal disagreement on future monetary policy direction. International energy prices remain above $100 per barrel, creating persistent inflation concerns across developed economies.
sections.Financial Markets: New York stock markets traded mixed as investors balanced the Fed's rate-holding decision against rising energy prices and geopolitical concerns, with the 10-year Treasury yield rising to 4.4%. The bond market showed weakness with yields rising significantly, while tech stocks provided support to indices despite broader market hesitation. Target-allocation funds have become increasingly popular investment vehicles, with record inflows of 3.3 trillion won as of January 2026, nearly tripling from previous years as investors seek volatility protection. The S&P 500 fell 2.85 points (0.04%), the Dow Jones dropped 280.12 points (0.57%), while the Nasdaq rose 9.441 points (0.04%) amid mixed trading sentiment. Investor sentiment reflects concerns about prolonged high energy prices and potential inflation resurgence despite Fed's measured policy stance.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea and Qatar expanded investment cooperation in advanced industries including manufacturing AI, robotics, semiconductors, and biotechnology, marking a shift beyond traditional energy-focused partnerships. AI-related market movements have reshaped stock rankings with components and power infrastructure companies gaining investor interest while battery and biotech stocks relatively underperformed. Hanwha Group entered the top five Korean conglomerates for the first time, driven by defense and shipbuilding sector strength amid geopolitical instability and conflict-related demands. Ninetech's subsidiary Energy 11 partnered with global IT material companies to commercialize all-solid-state batteries based on semi-solid electrolyte technology. The petrochemical sector benefited from government naphtha subsidies, allowing companies to stabilize operations and increase facility utilization despite high raw material costs.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment supply composition shifted toward 59 square meter units exceeding traditional 84 square meter supply as developers maximize profit margins through increased unit counts without reducing construction area. Korean Investment Real Estate Trust signed an MOU with Shilim District 6 redevelopment preparation committee to pursue residential redevelopment projects combining efficiency with community benefits. Seoul expanded youth monthly rent support programs to include childless newlyweds, youth single-parent families, and jeonse (lease fraud) victims, extending assistance to 15,000 beneficiaries receiving up to 200,000 won monthly for 12 months starting August. High-ranking government officials face renewed debate over blank-trust property systems to address multi-property ownership and capital gains controversies, emphasizing conflict-of-interest prevention. The real estate market reflects structural shifts as purchasing power constraints push first-time homebuyers toward smaller, more affordable units despite price increases.
sections.International Economy: Federal Reserve Chair Powell announced he will step down from his chairman position in May but continue serving as a board member, resisting political pressure from President Trump while maintaining the Fed's independence. The US Fed's divergent views on future monetary policy direction became evident with four dissenting votes, reflecting significant internal debate about appropriate policy responses to economic conditions. Trump administration pressure on monetary policy independence highlighted ongoing tensions between political leadership and central bank autonomy in setting interest rates. sections.AI & Economy: Google parent Alphabet reported 22% revenue increase to 163 trillion won in the first quarter, with cloud services revenue jumping 63% as AI demand accelerates across enterprise sectors. Amazon achieved record first-quarter revenue of 269 trillion won with 16.6% growth, driven by robust cloud and AI service expansion while custom-designed semiconductor businesses exceeded 20 billion dollar annual revenue. Tech giants are rapidly developing proprietary semiconductors to reduce NVIDIA dependence and maximize AI infrastructure efficiency across their cloud platforms. CJ Olivenetworks is establishing comprehensive AI education systems to transform all employees into 'AX natives' who integrate artificial intelligence into daily work operations across IT, development, and non-technical divisions. Demis Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind, predicted that artificial general intelligence will arrive within five years with impacts ten times larger and faster than previous industrial revolutions.
sections.Others: GM's Changwon factory in South Korea serves as the 'mother factory' for the company's global operations, with advanced automation replacing multi-worker assembly tasks through integrated robotic systems and AI-driven manufacturing.
